explanation: API lemma for erdosproblems.com/819 (used to derive the trivial upper bound f(N) ≤ (N+√N)/2, consistent with the Erdős–Freud upper bound (1/2+o(1))N quoted on the page). It states |A+A| ≤ C(|A|+1, 2) for a finite A ⊆ ℕ, which is the standard fact that every sum a+b comes from an unordered pair {a,b} with repetition allowed, of which there are C(|A|+1,2) = |Sym2 A|. The statement is mathematically correct and is proved in the file (via Finset.card_sym2 and an image argument), not sorried. Faithful.
